# improve git add

Add `git track <path>` that adds a file by its path relative to the repository root, because `git state`/`git status` print root-relative paths while `git add` resolves them against the current directory:

```bash
$ git add some.file
fatal: pathspec 'some.file' did not match any files
$ pwd
/some/root/path
$ cd ../
$ git add some.file
# success
```

```bash
$ git track some.file
# git add $(git root)/some.file
```
